title: Tesla's energy storage division to pick up slack as car margins drop and credits fade
title_zh: 随着汽车利润下降和信贷消失，特斯拉的能源存储部门将弥补颓势
summary: Tesla's solar and energy business is likely to outshine the EV maker's challenged core business when it reports quarterly results this week, a sign of resilience as Tesla ‌progresses slowly in its turn to robots and self-driving technology.
summary_zh: 特斯拉在本周公布季度业绩时，其太阳能和能源业务可能会超过这家电动汽车制造商面临挑战的核心业务，这是特斯拉在机器人和自动驾驶技术方面进展缓慢之际的韧性迹象。

title: Apple withholds data in India antitrust case, watchdog sets final hearing
title_zh: 苹果在印度反垄断案件中扣留数据，监管机构举行最终听证会
summary: By Aditya Kalra NEW DELHI, April 20 (Reuters) - Apple has not submitted data sought by India's antitrust body after an investigation found the U.S. firm abused its dominant position in the iPhone apps
summary_zh: 路透社新德里 4 月 20 日消息——印度反垄断机构调查发现，苹果公司滥用其在 iPhone 应用程序中的主导地位，但该机构尚未提交其要求的数据。

summary: The worst thing anyone could’ve done was make some bad trades in an effort to time the market’s peaks and troughs.
summary_zh: 任何人能做的最糟糕的事情就是为了把握市场的高峰和低谷时机而进行一些糟糕的交易。
